newsitem.title: UK: UK's Adscene in serious talks with bidder - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Adscene in serious talks with bidder - paper.

text.p: British regional newspaper publisher Adscene Group Plc is holding "serious talks" with a potential bidder, the Independent said on Friday.

It quoted industry sources as saying Harry Lambert, the group's chairman and chief executive, had received tentative approaches from several newspaper groups and had held formal talks with one of them.

The sources said those likely to have made moves to acquire Adscene included Northcliffe Newspapers, part of the Daily Mail & General Trust Plc, Trinity International Holdings Plc and Johnston Press Plc.
Southnews Plc was understood not to be making a bid as it viewed the asking price as being too high.
Adscene has a market capitalisation of around 31 million pounds on Thursday's closing London Stock Market price of 142.5 pence a share.
